reported_equality: Koan 1 + Loss of Divinity + Koan 2 without F = 1,814; Sign Post + Spirals without F = 1,814.
question: Does their printed-order alignment stand out after selecting the best of the same four pairwise operations used in the 1,894-rune baseline?
alphabet: 29 Gematria Primus rune indices, zero based; omit every ᚠ from both streams
score: Whole-output ordered equal-symbol pairs; maximum across all four operations.
control: Every nonzero circular shift of B, with the four-way maximum repeated; ties count as reaching the observed score.
exclusions: Other section combinations, F-removal rules, operations, uneven offsets, language scores, and adjustment for how this equality was discovered.
selection_disclosure: The equality was chosen from a previously published collection. Circular shifts condition on this choice and do not give a discovery-wide significance level.
